notes: GENESISToken (src/GENESISToken.sol) is the only contract in this launch; contracts is empty. It is a self-contained, fixed-supply ERC-20 named Genesis Agents (GENESIS) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments (constructorArgs is empty) and mints the entire supply of 1,000,000,000 GENESIS (1e27 minor units, token.totalSupply) once to msg.sender, which at launch is the ProjectFactory. The swarm's 10% is never subtracted by the token: the factory takes it from that balance and sends it to the launch's MerkleDistributor, then seeds the Uniswap v4 pool through the PoolManager (0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90) with economics.poolBps of the supply paired with IMD (pool.pairedCurrency), and forwards any remainder to economics.remainderTo. The token has no owner, no admin and no roles; every parameter is a compile-time constant. Nothing can mint or burn after construction, so totalSupply() is constant forever. transfer and transferFrom move exactly the requested amount for every caller: no fee, tax, limit, pause, blacklist or hook. There is no proxy, no upgradeability, no delegatecall, no selfdestruct and no external call anywhere in the contract. pool.fee 12500 and pool.tickSpacing 60 are the launch policy's. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: the sqrtPriceX96 of 2,500 IMD over 1e27 GENESIS units with GENESIS as currency0. The deployer derives the real opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, token.totalSupply and the deployed currency order.
